title: Which Value Stock Is the More Obvious Buy Now: Home Depot Under $310 a Share or Lowe's Under $200 a Share?
author: Lawrence Rothman, Cfa
description: Home Depot and Lowe's both trade at attractive valuations compared to their historical P/E ratios amid economic headwinds affecting the home-improvement retail sector.
